notes.title: 4 new languages!
notes.notes: The new demo of A Piano Tale is online! What's new: Bug fixes and addition of 4 new languages: Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, and Polish!

notes.title: Demo
notes.notes:
The demo is online for Windows, Mac and Ubuntu!

Don't hesitate to install it and write a positive evaluation!
